name: @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/browser-demo
description: Browser demo for Solana AI agents that sign through installed Wallet Standard wallets.

scripts.build: pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/core build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/ios-link build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/wallet-standard-web build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/mwa-mobile-web build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/embedded-wallet build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/walletconnect-solana build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/ledger-wallet build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/a2a-agent-card build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/acp-adapter build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/workflow build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/skills-runtime build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/launch-skills build && vite build && node scripts/prerender-legal.mjs
scripts.dev: pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/a2a-agent-card build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/acp-adapter build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/workflow build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/skills-runtime build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/launch-skills build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/ledger-wallet build && vite --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/core build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/ios-link build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/wallet-standard-web build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/mwa-mobile-web build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/embedded-wallet build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/walletconnect-solana build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/ledger-wallet build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/a2a-agent-card build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/acp-adapter build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/workflow build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/skills-runtime build && pnpm -F @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/launch-skills build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
